title: Looks Effective, But Not Study
text: Looks Effective, But Not Study. I REALLY wanted this to work.  Putting it together was fairly easy, but once it's together, the joints don't snap together evenly, so it looks like they're going to pop out and are a little sideways in some places.  You can really put a lot of things on these basket-shelves, but don't put anything heavy on them.  I don't know if these will stay up or not, but we'll see how they hold up.
